top_news.title: Whispering Wisely: Smart Subset Selection for ASR Fine-Tuning
top_news.dek: Researchers propose an embedding-based subset selection method to reduce the computational cost of fine-tuning ASR models like Whisper.
top_news.brief: Fine-tuning ASR models on large datasets is resource-intensive. This approach uses Whisper's pretrained encoder to map audio samples into an embedding space, then applies a greedy k-center algorithm to select a diverse, representative subset of data for training.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing audio samples mapped to an embedding space with selected representative clusters.

top_news.title: [AINews] Anthropic files for $2T IPO in 2 weeks: 1400% growth rate, 48% of revenue through cloud partners, 85% margin, $1B op profit in Q2, $134B cash in bank and $10B lifetime burn
top_news.dek: Anthropic has filed for a $2 trillion IPO, reporting high growth, strong margins, and significant operational profitability.
top_news.brief: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a 1400% growth rate, 85% margins, and $1 billion in Q2 operating profit. The company reports $134 billion in cash reserves against $10 billion in lifetime burn, with nearly half of its revenue generated through cloud partnerships.
top_news.image_alt: Financial growth chart representing Anthropic's IPO metrics.

top_news.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
top_news.dek: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4, a world model designed for high-fidelity, real-time interactive simulation.
top_news.brief: Genie 4 is DeepMind's latest world model, focusing on unprecedented realism in real-time environments. It aims to improve the accuracy of physical interactions and visual fidelity for AI training and simulation tasks.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of a realistic, interactive 3D environment generated by the Genie 4 model.

top_news.title: DeepMind unveils Genie 4 world model promising more realistic physics and humans
top_news.dek: Genie 4 adds audio and improved human realism to DeepMind's simulations, with developer access coming soon.
top_news.brief: Ars Technica reports that Genie 4 introduces audio capabilities and more realistic human representations. The model is scheduled for rollout to developers and Google AI Ultra subscribers in the near future.
top_news.image_alt: Illustration of a simulated human figure interacting with a digital environment.

top_news.title: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs
top_news.dek: AWS introduces SOCI indexing for SageMaker AI to lazy-load containers, reducing job startup time from minutes to seconds.
top_news.brief: Seekable OCI (SOCI) indexing removes full container image downloads from the critical path for SageMaker AI jobs. This lazy-loading approach starts containers in seconds without requiring changes to existing job definitions, reducing billable overhead.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a container image being partially loaded into a SageMaker AI instance.
